meta.description: Learn about Ultimate Hunting Safaris — our story, mission, and the experienced team behind world-class hunting expeditions in New Zealand, Africa, and Namibia.

story.label: OUR STORY
story.title: The Ethos of Ultimate Hunting Safaris
paragraphs: Founded on a deep reverence for the wild, Ultimate Hunting Safaris provides world-class expeditions across the globe. From the rugged highlands of New Zealand to the sun-drenched savannas of South Africa and the expansive plains of Namibia, our vision is to deliver the ultimate pursuit for both novice and seasoned marksmen.

We believe that a hunt is much more than a harvest; it is a sacred connection between humanity and the natural world. Our expeditions are meticulously designed to honor this ancient bond, prioritizing conservation, ethical stewardship, and the preservation of natural habitats. We operate as guests in the wilderness, ensuring that our presence helps sustain the vibrant wildlife for generations to come.

What truly sets us apart is our unyielding dedication to the craft of hunting. With decades of combined field experience, our team seamlessly fuses professional guiding with an intimate knowledge of the terrain and game. We cater to everyone from complete beginners seeking safe, guided instruction to experienced hunters looking for the ultimate trophy. At Ultimate Hunting Safaris, we hunt with purpose, respect the land, and celebrate the untamed spirit of the wilderness.

team.name: Lino Abraham
team.bio: Bringing unparalleled field expertise and a steady hand to every hunt, Lino is dedicated to ethical hunting practices. He works closely with beginners to build their confidence, using his patience and passion for teaching to transform first-time hunters into capable outdoorsmen.

team.name: Jacob Josemon
team.bio: The visionary behind Ultimate Hunting Safaris. With years of experience tracking big game across diverse continents, Jacob ensures that every expedition is meticulously planned and executed with the highest standards of safety, professionalism, and profound respect for the wild.

team.name: Raju Paul
team.bio: A highly skilled marksman and Licensed South African Hunting Guide. Raju brings specialized expertise in navigating complex terrain and tracking diverse big game across the African continent, ensuring an authentic, thrilling, and safe safari experience.
